name: MDPEP
summary: MDPEP (also known as MD-PV8 and MDPHPP) is a substituted cathinone derivative with stimulant effects which has been sold as a designer drug. It is the longer chain heptyl homologue of the well known stimulant designer drugs MDPV and MDPHP.

pharmacology.text: MDPEP (also known as MD-PV8 and MDPHPP) is a substituted cathinone derivative with stimulant effects which has been sold as a designer drug.

uses.text: MDPEP (also known as MD-PV8 and MDPHPP) is a substituted cathinone derivative with stimulant effects which has been sold as a designer drug. It is the longer chain heptyl homologue of the well known stimulant designer drugs MDPV and MDPHP.

summaryZh: MDPEP，也稱為MD-PV8、MDPHPP，化學名：1-[3,4-(亞甲二氧基)苯基]-2-(N-吡咯烷基)-1-庚酮，是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C18H25NO3，屬於卡西酮衍生物，與MDPV、MDPHP是同系物，2019年首次在瑞典的黑市上發現。
summaryZhHans: MDPEP，也称为MD-PV8、MDPHPP，化学名：1-[3,4-(亚甲二氧基)苯基]-2-(N-吡咯烷基)-1-庚酮，是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C18H25NO3，属于卡西酮衍生物，与MDPV、MDPHP是同系物，2019年首次在瑞典的黑市上发现。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it specifically. Pyrrolidine cathinones like MDPV can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, overheating, paranoia, psychosis and strong urges to redose, and have been linked to deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它本身所知甚少。MDPV 之類的吡咯烷卡西酮可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、體溫過高、偏執、精神病與強烈的追加使用衝動，也曾與死亡案例有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它本身所知甚少。MDPV 之类的吡咯烷卡西酮可能引起心跳过快、高血压、体温过高、偏执、精神病与强烈的追加使用冲动，也曾与死亡案例有关。

fact.en: MDPEP is a longer-tailed member of the MDPV family: MDPV has a five-carbon chain, MDPHP six, and MDPEP seven.
fact.zh: MDPEP 是 MDPV 家族中尾巴較長的成員：MDPV 有五個碳的鏈，MDPHP 有六個，MDPEP 則有七個。
fact.zhHans: MDPEP 是 MDPV 家族中尾巴较长的成员：MDPV 有五个碳的链，MDPHP 有六个，MDPEP 则有七个。
